- **Android**: Go to **Settings → Network & internet → SIMs** and toggle off your SIM (or turn on **Airplane Mode**).
- **To fully disconnect service**: Contact your carrier (e.g., Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) to suspend or cancel your line.
